Name: Pac-Man Ghost Pets
Author: lusif1
Description: This mod makes all of your pets into each of the different Pac ghosts, Inky, Blinky, Pinky, Funky, Clyde, and Sue They dance, They sleep, They are your pet for life, so take care of them! Choose which ghost you want to take care of upon creating a new save, or get surprised when you load into your current game, the choice is yours!
